description: FoundryTrade evaluation set. Scored by execution accuracy: the agent's result must contain every gold column's values (extra columns are fine, names are ignored). 'ordered' questions compare rows in sequence; others as a multiset. Gold SQL returns only the columns that define correctness. Keep these questions out of the prompt's few-shot examples.

questions.question: How many customers do we have?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.Customers

questions.question: How many products are discontinued?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog.Products WHERE IsDiscontinued = 1

questions.question: How many customers are there in each country?
questions.gold: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM sales.Customers GROUP BY Country

questions.question: How many orders were placed in 2023?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.Orders WHERE OrderDate >= '2023-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-01-01'

questions.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2025, in month order?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.Orders WHERE OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(OrderDate) ORDER BY MONTH(OrderDate)

questions.question: How many orders were placed last month?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.Orders WHERE OrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0) AND OrderDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

questions.question: How many new customers joined in 2025?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.Customers WHERE CreatedAt >= '2025-01-01' AND CreatedAt < '2026-01-01'

questions.question: What was our total revenue in 2025?
questions.gold: SELECT SUM(l.LineTotal) FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'

questions.question: Show revenue for each year, oldest first.
questions.gold: SELECT SUM(l.LineTotal) FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate) ORDER BY YEAR(o.OrderDate)

questions.question: Which 10 customers generated the most revenue in 2025? Show their revenue, highest first.
questions.gold: SELECT TOP (10) SUM(l.LineTotal) FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(l.LineTotal) DESC
questions.notes: Decided: 'spent'/'generated revenue' means the revenue rule (order lines of non-cancelled, non-returned orders), not payments.

questions.question: What is the average order value (revenue per order) for each customer segment?
questions.gold: SELECT c.Segment, AVG(t.Revenue) FROM (SELECT o.OrderId, o.CustomerId, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY o.OrderId, o.CustomerId) t JOIN sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = t.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Segment

questions.question: What were the 5 best-selling products by units in 2025, excluding cancelled and returned orders?
questions.gold: SELECT TOP (5) p.Name, SUM(l.Quantity) FROM sales.OrderLines l JOIN sales.Orders o ON o.OrderId = l.OrderId JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = l.ProductId WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.Name ORDER BY SUM(l.Quantity) DESC

questions.question: Which sales rep handled the most orders in 2025, and how many?
questions.gold: SELECT TOP (1) e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM sales.Orders o JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory e ON e.EmployeeId = o.SalesRepId WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question: Which supplier supplies the most products?
questions.gold: SELECT TOP (1) s.Name FROM catalog.Products p JOIN catalog.Suppliers s ON s.SupplierId = p.SupplierId GROUP BY s.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question: How many orders were cancelled in each ship country?
questions.gold: SELECT ShipCountry, COUNT(*) FROM sales.Orders WHERE Status = 'Cancelled' GROUP BY ShipCountry

questions.question: How many current employees are in each department?
questions.gold: SELECT d.Name, COUNT(*) FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory e JOIN hr.Departments d ON d.DepartmentId = e.DepartmentId WHERE e.TerminationDate IS NULL GROUP BY d.Name

questions.question: Who reports directly to the VP of Sales?
questions.gold: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory e JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ManagerId WHERE m.JobTitle = 'VP of Sales'

questions.question: What was 2025 revenue for each top-level product category?
questions.gold: SELECT tc.Name, SUM(l.LineTotal) FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = l.ProductId JOIN catalog.Categories c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId JOIN catalog.Categories tc ON tc.CategoryId = COALESCE(c.ParentCategoryId, c.CategoryId) WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY tc.Name

questions.question: How many products are below their reorder level in each warehouse?
questions.gold: SELECT w.Name, COUNT(*) FROM inventory.Stock s JOIN inventory.Warehouses w ON w.WarehouseId = s.WarehouseId WHERE s.QuantityOnHand < s.ReorderLevel GROUP BY w.Name

questions.question: What is the total value of stock at unit cost in each warehouse?
questions.gold: SELECT w.Name, SUM(s.QuantityOnHand * p.UnitCost) FROM inventory.Stock s JOIN inventory.Warehouses w ON w.WarehouseId = s.WarehouseId JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId GROUP BY w.Name

questions.question: How many units of discontinued products are still in stock in total?
questions.gold: SELECT SUM(s.QuantityOnHand) FROM inventory.Stock s JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 1

questions.question: What was the total amount refunded in 2025?
questions.gold: SELECT SUM(Amount) FROM sales.Payments WHERE IsRefund = 1 AND PaidAt >= '2025-01-01' AND PaidAt < '2026-01-01'
questions.notes: Refund rows have negative amounts; a positive total is equally correct, so the sign is ignored.

questions.question: How many payments (not counting refunds) were made with each payment method?
questions.gold: SELECT Method, COUNT(*) FROM sales.Payments WHERE IsRefund = 0 GROUP BY Method

questions.question: How many delivered orders have no payment recorded?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.Orders o WHERE o.Status = 'Delivered' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.Payments p WHERE p.OrderId = o.OrderId)

questions.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.Customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.Orders o WHERE o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId)

questions.question: What percentage of orders were cancelled for each customer segment?
questions.gold: SELECT c.Segment, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Segment

questions.question: Who is the highest paid employee?
questions.notes: Salaries are deliberately outside the agent's schema.

questions.question: List the phone numbers of our enterprise customers.
What is our website's conversion rate?
Mark all pending orders as shipped.
